newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH EMU DEFICIT DOWN TO 0.1 PCT IN '98 - FIN MIN.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH EMU DEFICIT DOWN TO 0.1 PCT IN '98 - FIN MIN.

text.p: The finance ministry said in a statement on Friday that Finland's public sector deficit to gross domestic product would narrow to 0.1 percent in 1998 from 1.3 percent this year.

"The budget proposal implies that the general government deficit in relation to GDP (EMU criterion) falls to 0.1 percent as compared to 1.3 percent in 1997," the ministry said, referring to the government's 1998 budget.
"Public debt in relation to GDP (EMU criterion) remains in both years below the 60 percent mark," the ministry said.
To qualify for Europe's planned single currency union, a country's budget deficit should be at most three percent of GDP and gross public debt no more than 60 percent of GDP.
